device.title: Notifications on this device
device.description: Get a notification here as things happen: offers, bookings, messages. Tips and news never come this way.
device.blocked: Notifications are blocked for TasksNearMe in this browser. Allow them in the browser's site settings, then come back.
device.unsupported: This browser can't show notifications from websites. Email and texts still reach you.
device.installFirst: On iPhone and iPad, add TasksNearMe to your Home Screen first (Share, then "Add to Home Screen"), then turn notifications on from there.
device.notSetUp: Notifications on devices aren't set up here yet. Email and texts still reach you.
device.failed: That didn't work. Try again, or check the browser's notification settings.

prompt.offersTitle: Hear about offers as they come
prompt.offersBody: Turn on notifications on this device and we'll tell you the moment a helper makes an offer.
prompt.tasksTitle: Hear about new tasks near you
prompt.tasksBody: Turn on notifications on this device and new tasks in your area reach you first.
prompt.done: You're set. Notifications will come to this device.
